rows.note: Use this when the promotion mainly means a discount or special offer to customers.

example.english: This shop is running a promotion: buy two items and get one free.
example.traditional: 呢間舖做緊優惠，買兩件平一件。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou2 zou6 gan2 jau1 wai6 maai5 loeng5 gin6 ping4 jat1 gin6

rows.note: Use this for a marketing event aimed at promoting a product or brand rather than merely offering a discount.

example.english: The mall held a promotion for a new brand.
example.traditional: 商場搞咗個新品牌推廣活動。
example.jyutping: soeng1 coeng4 gaau2 zo2 go3 san1 ban2 paai4 teoi1 gwong2 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this for publicizing an idea or information to make it better known.

example.english: The film company is doing promotion online.
example.traditional: 間電影公司喺網上做宣傳。
